catalogs.reason: New source or extraction configuration; review initial listings

limits: All published guides were included in the objective/source sweeps; this is not a new technical review or lab execution for every guide.

Forty objectives require manual extraction. Twenty-seven active-exam PDFs match the September 17 bytes; the separately retired SOL-C01 transition PDF also matches. Identical PDFs do not prove all linked product behavior remains current.
The remaining 13 manual objective results include Salesforce, MongoDB, ServiceNow, Python Institute and JS Institute. No enrollment, private portal, or authenticated blueprint was accessed.
Six discovery sources still require manual retrieval: Cisco, MongoDB, ServiceNow, IBM and two OpenAI pages. Prior September 17 manual checks are historical evidence, not new passes.
Source-health blocked results include rate limits, bot protection, login barriers and provider request policies. Five repeatable 404s remain unresolved; no guessed replacement URL was accepted.
A supplemental overview fetch attempted 323 URLs; transport failures and short application shells prevent claiming a fresh lifecycle review of every overview.
Accepted objective snapshots and full-review/AI-audit dates were preserved. The newly added Security+ selector baseline was accepted only after its two version pages were inspected.
